name: Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago
insider_take: This soaring 98-story architectural marvel stands as Chicago's second-tallest building, offering unparalleled luxury in the heart of the Magnificent Mile.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 14-27 of the iconic spired tower designed by Adrian Smith, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking views of Lake Michigan, the Chicago River, and the city skyline. Each suite averages 675 square feet, making them among the largest in Chicago, and the building's unique three-tier structure creates an instantly recognizable addition to the city's famous skyline.
pro_tip: Book a river-facing suite to watch the famous Chicago Architecture Foundation boat tours pass by while you enjoy room service – it's like having a front-row seat to the city's most popular attraction.
dont_miss: The 16th-floor Terrace at Trump, Chicago's highest outdoor hotel bar, offers craft cocktails with panoramic views. Just steps away, explore the Chicago Riverwalk, catch a show in the nearby Theater District, or indulge in world-class shopping along the Magnificent Mile – all within a two-block radius.
pros: Prime downtown Chicago location near Magnificent Mile
Luxury tower with stunning city and river views
Spacious suites with full kitchens and high-end amenities
World-class spa and fine dining restaurant on-site
cons: Busy downtown location with urban noise levels
